test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is the correct full form of GDFCF?

options.text: Gross Development on Fixed Capital Formation

solution:
The correct answer is __**Gross Domestic Fixed Capital Formation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• GDFCF is measured by following 
 
 
• The total value of a **producer's acquisition**, **fewer disposals**, of **fixed assets **during the **accounting period**.
 
• Certain additions to the value of **non-produced assets are **realized by the **productive activity **of **institutional units**.
 
 
 
• It also meant **gross capital formation consists **of **outlays **on additions to the **fixed assets **of the **economy **plus **net changes **in the **level of inventories**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__** 

 
• GFCF(Gross Fixed Capital Formation)
 
 
• It is a component of the **expenditure **on **gross domestic product **and thus shows something about how much of the **new value added **to the **economy **is **invested **rather than **consumed.**
